cohort: Primiparous women aged 40 years or older carrying a single fetus, who delivered at a tertiary, university-affiliated medical center between 2007 and 2014
finding: Advanced maternal age primiparous women attempting a trial of labor have comparable outcomes to those seeking scheduled cesarean delivery, however, women with a failed trial of labor have higher rates of adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with a failed trial of labor had higher rates of adverse neonatal outcomes compared to those with a successful trial of labor or scheduled cesarean delivery.
